children: IBEX strengthened its financing flexibility by amending both its U.S. and UAE credit arrangements with HSBC. In the U.S., the company extended the maturity of its $25 million secured revolver to the earlier of October 22, 2029 or the maturity of the amended UAE facilities, with a 0.20% closing fee and a 0.30% commitment fee on unused capacity. In the UAE, IBEX extended maturities to October 22, 2029, maintained a committed $50 million post-shipment seller revolving loan, added a $1 million performance bond line, and kept a $50,000 card facility, alongside a 0.20% renewal fee and a 0.30% unused commitment fee. A security agreement grants a charge over UAE receivables up to $58.905 million, supporting collateral and liquidity.
Agreement 1: IBEX Amends $25M U.S. Revolver, Extends Maturity to 2029 With HSBC
: Amendment to secured $25 million revolving credit facility
: HSBC Bank USA, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Until Oct 22 2029 or earlier linked event
Agreement 2: IBEX UAE Amends Facilities to 2029, Adds $1M Performance Bond; Grants Receivables Security
: Amended UAE credit facilities with receivables security
: Extend maturity and support working capital and guarantees
